overall.summary: Nothing is refuted: coverage, function preservation, closed forms and every probed number, threshold, direction and shape reproduce, and the sodium V and the pulse-pressure saddle are real. Four minor weakenings: the penalty chain is a weighted-sum threshold rather than strictly 'jointly high', one young-high-sodium threshold is about 1.5 mmol/L high, one creatinine sweep endpoint is outside the data, and one AUC is double-rounded (0.876 for 0.8766).

findings.statement: A two-unit chain that switches on when systolic blood pressure and heart rate are jointly high ... it is the part that makes the joint response fall when both are high
findings.check: subgroup by the four sbp 132 / heart rate 76 quadrants; probe thresholds
findings.evidence: The chain is a threshold on a weighted sum (about sbp + 1.5 x heart rate), not an AND of two highs: of the 733 rows where it acts, 334 are in the both-high quadrant, but 249 of the 394 low-pressure/high-rate rows (63%, mean contribution -1.40) and 150 of the 404 high-pressure/low-rate rows (37%) also have it on. It opens at heart rate 92 when sbp is 100 mmHg and at heart rate 59 when sbp is 170. The hypothesis does say 'a weighted sum', and it is off in all 368 both-low rows, so 'jointly high' is a partial overclaim, not wrong.
commands: uv run python -m explaneat verify subgroup experiments/ushape_saddle/explanations/shape-C.json --where "sbp <= 132 and heart_rate > 76"
uv run python -m explaneat verify subgroup experiments/ushape_saddle/explanations/shape-C.json --where "sbp > 132 and heart_rate <= 76"
uv run python -m explaneat verify probe experiments/ushape_saddle/explanations/shape-C.json --no-parts --nodes 3040,3544 --set sbp=100 --sweep heart_rate=90,92,94,95

findings.statement: at age 40 it is on from sodium 138 mmol/L (0.29)
findings.check: probe --set age=40 --sweep sodium=136,137,138 --nodes 1269
findings.evidence: At age 40 (typical heart rate) node 1269 is already on at 137 mmol/L (0.10) and off at 136 (pre-activation -0.085): it opens at about 136.5, so 'on from 138' places the threshold about 1.5 mmol/L too high. The 138 value (0.29) and the other brackets (age 62: off at 140, on at 142; age 80: off at 142, on at 146, actual opening about 144) reproduce.

findings.statement: a concordant raised pressure and pulse (high rate-pressure product) lowers the predicted risk; bradycardia with low pressure is predicted lowest risk
findings.check: domain sense
findings.evidence: The model predicts below 1% for sbp 170 with heart rate 100 and 0.2% for sbp 90 with heart rate 45. Clinically, hypertension with tachycardia and also hypotension with bradycardia would usually be seen as higher risk. The training data agree with the model (both-high quadrant observed 28.7%, both-low 23.4%, against 59% and 52% in the discordant quadrants), so this is a flag on the data-generating process, not a model error.

sodium_V.why: An asymmetric V in serum sodium with its minimum at about 138.7 mmol/L and a high side about 2.6 times steeper; the model confirms it (concept R-squared 0.998).

tachycardia_low_sbp_gate.why: A pulse-fast-for-the-pressure (shock-index-like) gate whose thresholds move with sbp and sodium exactly as stated.

hypertension_low_hr_gate.why: A pressure-high-for-the-pulse gate whose thresholds move with heart rate and sodium exactly as stated.

high_sbp_and_hr_penalty.why: The 'jointly high' reading holds in the both-high corner, but the chain is a threshold on sbp + 1.5 x heart rate and also acts on 399 discordant-quadrant patients.

sbp_hinge.why: Risk rises linearly with systolic pressure above about 124 mmHg; a small but real reading, confirmed (off below 123 in every row).

young_high_sodium_tachy.why: A high-sodium gate that opens earlier in younger and faster-pulsed patients and flattens the low end of the age response; confirmed, with one threshold about 1.5 mmol/L off.

diabetes_step.why: A fixed step for diabetics (typical risk 15% to 23%), confirmed.

linear_terms.why: Five positive, monotone direct effects (age and creatinine largest) plus a spurious noise weight, all confirmed by sweeps.
